ptzCameras.notes: 1/1.3-inch CMOS, 18x optical (focal ratio 171/9.5 = 18.0x). Focal 9.5-171 mm, HFOV 51 to 3.6 deg and active image size 9.19 x 5.17 mm published by Z CAM (P2-R1 product page and a spec image from a Z CAM representative, 2026-10-22). A Z CAM representative (2026-10-27): the published values are mass-production measured data; FOV is identical in 4K and 1080p, no crop. Consistency note: wide end matches focal and active width (calc 51.62 deg), tele published 3.6 deg is wider than focal and active width imply (calc 3.08 deg); manufacturer value kept as published. P2-R1 and P2-R1N share lens and sensor, NDI is the only difference (Z CAM representative, 2026-10-23). NDI|HX3 offered as a separately purchased upgrade license. Current.
